reuse.why: The new last-month action reuses getAverageFillCategories, shouldFillCategory, averageToBudgetAmount, getSheetValue and the mutator/undoable registration, but setZero re-writes the category query instead of reusing the shared loader.

duplication.why: setZero inlines the same categories/category_groups/notes SQL as getAverageFillCategories, and the notes join is also repeated in getBudgetData, so the data feeding the rule is assembled in three places.

placement.why: The selection rule, template and #fixed checks live in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use them, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes stay on month-wide actions, their data queries, the DB view type and release notes.

maintainability.why: One shouldFillCategory owns the rule with a clear comment, but helpers named for averages (getAverageFillCategories, averageToBudgetAmount) now serve setLastMonthSpending too, and the triplicated query means a future rule input must be added in several SQL strings.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/actions.ts setZero runs its own copy of the getAverageFillCategories SQL rather than calling the loader (with includeHidden passed through).

disguised_duplication.where: The setZero query is an open copy of the loader's SQL, not renamed or reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldFillCategory and getAverageFillCategories gained the includeHiddenCategories parameter (threaded through every action); the template and #fixed checks apply to all callers rather than special cases; setZero bypasses the shared loader with its own query, and the average-named helpers are stretched to the last-month action.
